description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'EmployeeServiceTest' for testing the 'EmployeeService' component of the OrangeHRM PIM (Personnel Information Management) plugin. It includes setup, mock-based unit tests for various methods of EmployeeService such as getting DAOs, services, checking supervisor status, deleting employees, and ensuring email uniqueness.

classes.name: EmployeeServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for EmployeeService, testing DAO retrieval, subordinate/supervisor ID methods, supervisor status check, deletion, and email uniqueness validation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeService instance before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDao
methods.description: Tests that getEmployeeDao() returns an instance of EmployeeDao.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEventService
methods.description: Tests that getEmployeeEventService() returns an EmployeeEventService instance.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeTerminationService
methods.description: Tests that getEmployeeTerminationService() returns an EmployeeTerminationService instance.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateIdListBySupervisorId
methods.description: Tests getSubordinateIdListBySupervisorId() for both includeChain=true and null cases, using mock DAOs and config service.

methods.name: testIsSupervisor
methods.description: Verifies isSupervisor() correctly calls DAO and returns boolean status.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployees
methods.description: Tests deleteEmployees() method returns the correct number of deleted employees.

methods.name: testGetSupervisorIdListBySubordinateId
methods.description: Tests getSupervisorIdListBySubordinateId() for both includeChain=true and null cases.

methods.name: testIsUniqueEmail
methods.description: Tests isUniqueEmail() method's behavior with various email inputs using fixture data.
